episodes.name: Love, AD Style
episodes.overview: When Roger hires Hayley as a singer in his new bar, he becomes enthralled by her voice; Stan tries to prove his masculinity by negotiating a good deal on a new car.

episodes.name: Killer Vacation
episodes.overview: During the Smith family's tropical vacation, Stan is ordered to kill the activities director at their resort; Jeff and Hayley try to rekindle their romance.

episodes.name: Can I Be Frank with You?
episodes.overview: Francine thinks Stan spends too much time with his friends; a boy band recruits Steve and his friends for a music video.

episodes.name: American Stepdad
episodes.overview: When Stan invites his recently widowed mother to move in, she and Roger fall in love and wed; Steve and his friends find a lost movie script.

episodes.name: Why Can't We Be Friends?
episodes.overview: When Stan decides that Snot isn't cool enough to be Steve's best friend, he tries to separate them by staging a shooting at an ice cream parlor.

episodes.name: Adventures in Hayleysitting
episodes.overview: When Steve's baby sitter is unavailable, Stan and Francine decide to leave him with Hayley; Steve sneaks out to a party to prove he's not a goody-goody.

episodes.name: National Treasure 4: Baby Franny: She's Doing Well: The Hole Story
episodes.overview: A talk show reveals that Francine was the toddler who, famously, was rescued from a well by a firefighter; Francine makes a discovery when she falls down the well on the anniversary of her rescue; Stan and Roger come up with a business idea.

episodes.name: Finger Lenting Good
episodes.overview: The Smiths get drunk at Roger's Mardi Gras party and make a pact with Bullock; Roger tries to find the person who left a pastie in the attic.

episodes.name: The Adventures of Twill Ongenbone and His Boy Jabari
episodes.overview: Francine regrets deciding to teach Roger the value of hard work; Steve interviews Stan for a school project.

episodes.name: Blood Crieth Unto Heaven
episodes.overview: When Francine invites Stan's father to a party, a dark secret about the Smith family's past is revealed.

episodes.name: Max Jets
episodes.overview: Roger announces that Max Jets, a character who showers the Smith family with money, is making a return; a gold-digging waitress romances Max and threatens the family's inheritance.

episodes.name: Naked to the Limit, One More Time
episodes.overview: Roger pretends to be Jeff's imaginary friend so he can roam around the house without a disguise; when Jeff realizes Roger is an alien, Stan issues an ultimatum -- either Roger or Jeff must be killed; Steve becomes insecure about his body.

episodes.name: For Black Eyes Only
episodes.overview: When Black Villain shoots Stan's new wife, Sexpun Tocome, on their honeymoon, Stan teams up with his nemesis to take him down.

episodes.name: Spelling Bee My Baby
episodes.overview: Francine tries to rig the school spelling bee so that Steve will win; Stan and Roger try to rush Hayley's grieving process so she will be available to judge their badminton game.

episodes.name: The Missing Kink
episodes.overview: Francine tries to get Stan to spice up their sex life; Hayley tries to get back into dating and accepts a date with Snot.

episodes.name: The Boring Identity
episodes.overview: When Stan gets amnesia, Francine tries to turn him into her ideal husband; Steve is drawn into the corrupt side of Roger's paper route business.

episodes.name: The Full Cognitive Redaction of Avery Bullock by the Coward Stan Smith
episodes.overview: Stan is shocked when he is told that Deputy Director Bullock is showing early signs of dementia and needs his memory erased; Roger hires an old friend to help Steve with a bully at school.

episodes.name: Lost in Space
episodes.overview: Jeff must prove his love for Hayley to Emperor Zing in order to find his way home from the spaceship that abducted him.

episodes.name: Da Flippity Flop
episodes.overview: When Stan refuses to switch Klaus back into his original body, he steals Stan's body; Roger builds a gym in the attic.
